name: SVRecon
definition: A generalization of SVRaster to surface reconstruction by parametrizing each voxel with SDF values at its corners, enabling implicit geometry regularization and extraction of watertight meshes.
summary: SVRecon is a surface reconstruction method that uses Signed Distance Functions to extract watertight meshes, avoiding the depth bias of SVRaster and the SfM dependency of 3D Gaussian Splatting.
